results.description:
CALL AND TEXT ON A SECOND PHONE NUMBER WITH A FREE TRIAL SUBSCRIPTION

Hushed gives you a second phone number you can use for online dating, travel, shopping, moving, selling items, and more.

Choose from phone numbers in 300+ area codes and start calling and texting immediately on your very own Hushed number.

More than 25 million people have downloaded Hushed, making more than 450 million phone calls and sending more than 1 billion texts.

Why everyone loves Hushed:

INTERNET CALLING: Make phone calls over the internet (data or Wi-Fi) from anywhere in the world.

TEXT MESSAGES: Send and receive text messages, including photos and videos.

SECOND PHONE NUMBER: Get as many phone numbers as you want. Hushed makes it easy to manage different contacts and situations.

300+ AREA CODES: Pick a phone number with a United States area code, Canada area code, or United Kingdom area code — even if you’re travelling halfway across the world.

VOICEMAIL INCLUDED: Every Hushed number includes features like voicemail, call forwarding, call routing, and auto-reply texts.

VoIP TECHNOLOGY: Since Hushed calls and texts run over the internet using VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), you can communicate worldwide without traditional long-distance charges.

NO SIM CARD NEEDED: Your Hushed numbers are stored in the app, so there’s no need to swap SIM cards.

NO CONTRACTS: Hushed keeps things flexible, and you can cancel anytime.

FLEXIBLE USE: Use your second phone number for short-term or long-term needs. Keep it as long as you’d like.

Popular reasons for getting a second phone number:

ONLINE DATING: Use a second phone number when connecting with new people.

SELLING ITEMS ONLINE: Add a second phone number to online listings and remove it later if you no longer need it.

MOVING: Get a second phone number in your new area code before you relocate. Perfect for setting up utilities and services.

TRAVEL: Add a second phone number in the area code you’ll be visiting to help manage calling costs.

FAMILY & FRIENDS: Choose a second phone number with a local area code for easier communication.

SHOPPING: Provide your Hushed number when signing up for store programs or offers.

ACCOUNT VERIFICATION: Some services allow Hushed numbers to receive verification codes by text or call, depending on their policies.

FORMS & SIGN-UPS: Use a second phone number when registering for websites, forms, or subscriptions.

Ready for a second phone number?

FLEXIBLE PLANS: Choose from 1- and 3-line subscriptions with U.S., Canada, or U.K. numbers. Enjoy unlimited calls and texts, with savings available on annual plans.

CONVENIENT BILLING: Subscriptions renew automatically unless deactivated at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle. Manage or cancel your subscription in your device settings under Settings / Subscriptions.

KEEP IN MIND: Hushed is not suitable for 911 or emergency services. Please use your primary phone number for emergency calls.

Download Hushed and get your own second phone number today. Need help? Our team is available 24/7 via live chat (hushed.com) or email (support@hushed.com).
